findings.highlight: That golden mane is wet, so it looks different than usual.
findings.evidenceJa: 金の髪は濡れていて、いつもとは違っていた。
findings.governingReading: Saber’s golden hair hangs wet to her shoulders and looks unlike its usual braided form.
findings.explanation: Saber’s wet golden hair becomes an animal mane.

findings.highlight: "Yes. I discovered this when I became a Servant. In life, I was prevented from taking baths by the prying eyes all around me."
findings.evidenceJa: 「ええ、私もサーヴァントになって知りました。以前は周囲の目があって、湯浴みなど出来ませんでしたから」
findings.governingReading: Saber says that in life she could not bathe because of the eyes and attention around her.
findings.explanation: Surrounding public attention becomes prying eyes that prevented bathing.

findings.highlight: That much, I'd accepted. But what I just saw isn't fair to my faint heart.
findings.evidenceJa: —だっていうのに、今のは反則だ。
findings.governingReading: Shirou calls the contrast in Saber’s appearance unfair because it overwhelms him, without yet understanding why.
findings.explanation: A figurative “that is unfair” gains explicit romantic vulnerability.

findings.highlight: I didn't think it was real, since I was so surprised at the time. But today is different...
findings.evidenceJa: あの時はただビックリして実感できなかったが、今のは違う。
findings.governingReading: During the prior bath encounter Shirou was too surprised to feel or internalize what Saber’s femininity meant.
findings.explanation: Failing to register Saber’s girlhood becomes doubting the prior event was real.

findings.highlight: I don't know what to do, so I just end up staring at the ceiling.
findings.evidenceJa: 自分が何をしたいのかも分からず、呆然と天井を見上げる。
findings.governingReading: Shirou bangs his head against the wall without understanding his own impulse or what he wants.
findings.explanation: Not knowing what he wants to do becomes not knowing what to do.
